data.change_summary: Added two regression tests to crates/tank_core/tests/cycling.rs that verify all four nitrogen guilds (decomposers, AOB, NOB, comammox) produce volume-independent concentration kinetics. Test 1 (concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent) compares 10L vs 100L tanks with identical concentrations and proportional biomass, asserting equal Monod factors and equal per-liter concentration deltas for TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, and DON. Test 2 (concentration_kinetics_volume_independent_extreme_scales) stresses the same invariant at 1L vs 1000L to catch floating-point scaling issues. Both tests zero growth yields and decay rates to isolate kinetics from population dynamics, disable non-nitrogen systems, and scale flow_lph proportionally to volume.
outstanding_risks: The tests zero growth yields and decay rates to isolate kinetics; if a future volume leak is introduced specifically in the growth/decay pathway (not the Monod rate path), these tests would not catch it. A follow-up test with non-zero growth yields and appropriately scaled carrying capacity could cover that.
The tank_scenarios crate had a pre-existing compilation error (algae field rename) that was auto-fixed during the session — this was not caused by the new test but was a prerequisite for compilation.

steps.description: Explored codebase to understand nitrogen_cycle implementation, TankState structure, Monod factor computation, existing test patterns, and volume/geometry relationships
Designed test strategy: scale all dissolved pools and biomass proportionally to volume so concentration deltas cancel, zero growth/decay to isolate kinetics, scale flow_lph for identical flow_factor
Added import of legacy_total_param_to_mg_per_l to cycling.rs for manual Monod factor verification

Implemented concentration_kinetics_are_volume_independent test (10L vs 100L): verifies Monod factors equality pre-tick, then asserts per-liter concentration deltas for all five species (TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON) are equal within 1e-9 tolerance
Implemented concentration_kinetics_volume_independent_extreme_scales test (1L vs 1000L): same invariants at 1000× volume ratio using custom geometry to stress floating-point edge cases
Fixed pre-existing compilation error in tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs (algae field rename from _mg_total to _mg_n_per_l/_mg_p_per_l)
Ran cargo test, cargo clippy, and cargo fmt to validate all 14 cycling tests pass with no warnings or formatting issues in modified file

Test 1 explicitly verifies 5 Monod limitation factors are equal between small and large tanks before the tick
Test 1 asserts 5 concentration deltas (TAN, NO2, NO3, DOC, DON) are equal within 1e-9
Test 2 repeats the concentration delta check at 1L vs 1000L extreme scale
